notes.title: Little Update + Statement
notes.notes:
Since there haven't been any official announcements here for a while, we would like to mention the current work and address the criticism received.

Development Status

World of Retailing has not received any further public updates since the last major update (towards the end of 2022), but we assure you that we are still working on the game, albeit at a slower pace due to time constraints.


 The current development status includes several bug fixes:

 Fixed an issue where interactions were indicated even when there was no possibility for interaction.

 The BlackMarket was not available for rent or purchase.

 NPCs became increasingly rare in the city after a certain amount of playtime due to faulty spawn conditions.

 NPCs were unable to make any more purchases after spending a certain amount (based on their starting budget) because they no longer had enough money for most products. The limit for when NPCs can buy things has been increased, and the respawn behavior of NPCs has been changed to prevent complete bankruptcy.

 The decision-making process of NPCs has been adjusted to be more dynamic, especially regarding the potential opening of the BlackMarket, which requires higher fluctuation to be effectively utilized.

 The tutorial NPC now has an additional condition before being able to move from their current spot to the next, ensuring that the player doesn't lose sight of them. Additionally, the tutorial NPC has been given the ability to take alternative paths, providing the player with easier routes.

 The engine sound of vehicles could not be adjusted higher or lower regardless of the setting. This can now be controlled using the "SFX Volume" slider.


- There are also already parts of the new systems for future personnel management (and therefore for the staff themselves).

notes.title: Update 0.4 [CB Merge]
notes.notes:
We've updated to our latest state!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41919635/d169762f38364e205d6981470dcff41d443747a2.png


- The NPC-AI has been reworked entirely, each reported bug has been completely fixed and their behaviour has been updated.

- A new region has been unlocked, rumors said that mostly richlings live there.

- The new Talent-System has been implemented.
You can now skill into the Industry-Path.

- The 'Wholesaler' is now part of the game - you have to buy products at his store and transport them into your shops.

- The old house at R14 Street was removed, you will find the local "Wholesaler" there now.

- The Shelf-System has been updated, you can now define layouts for each table which get saved.

- Products on shelves can now be stacked depending on their base price to allow for more profit in grocery stores.

- A Gas-Station, which sells different types of fuel for different types of cars.
Depening on type and day, the prices can rise or fall.
You can also fill up canisters if you have to get fuel for a vehicle that ran out of fuel.

- The Car-Dealer now sells trucks, vans and trailers (if you have the right drivers license).
These vehicles can store a different amount of pallets/boxes which you can transport to your shops.
Also, these vehicles need fuel, which you have to buy from the local Gas-Station!

- The Bank now offers loans for you in order to give you some headroom for projects.

- We have implemented "Store-Upgrades" which allows you to hire security personal and also add Anti-Theft scanners at given store.

- We have reworked the whole tutorial to give the player a better introduction to our game.
We also have implemented a Skip function to walking scenes in case you don't want to wait.

- We have further improved the performance of our game to grant users with low end hardware a better gaming experience.

notes.title: The full release is being postponed.
notes.notes:
As stated in the title, we need to push the release back.

We are working hard to provide World of Retailing with frequent updates - as you could read in our last announcement, we are going to release plenty new content.

Due to these updates, we are pushing the final release back.
This way, we will have enough time to check everything that we add.

However, we don't let you down:
As announced on our Discord, we have launched a beta-branch for World of Retailing in which you can always test our latest updates, as well as reporting bugs in it so that they are fixed before the state is pushed into the release branch.

Inside the Beta-Branch, you will find frequent updates (usually every 2-3 days).
The beta is fully compatible with the current release-version, so you don't have to worry about your save-games.

You can join the beta branch like this: 
World of Retailing -> Properties -> BETAS -> beta

notes.title: We are working on the next big update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We would like to inform you about the next big update.

What will this update include?

- Sabotage against the competition. [e.g.: spreading dirt around the shops, spreading rumors around town, etc.]

- Competition to be eliminated that will regularly sabotage you.

- Products that you can buy from the competition [e.g.: a cell phone to report crimes, energy drinks to temporarily increase running speed, etc.]

- A talent and level system.

- An indicator on the map to check the "health" of a shop. [Stats like: estimated sales per day, aggression towards you, reputation of the store]

- Advertising posters in the world that can be used for marketing.

- Spying by and against competitors.

- You can manually adjust the prices of your products.

- Random street events through which you can get money and items. [Quests, NPC Interaction, Robbery]

- Products are no longer put into the inventory immediately, instead they are either delivered [with a delay, at an additional cost] or picked up.

- An office complex in which there are several offices. [among others: player office, office for suppliers]

- A health department that regularly visits all shops and, if necessary, requests cleaning.

- A new employee management system through which employees can be hired and promoted.

- Opening hours for the shops, which can be adjusted.

- Changed amount of NPCs in the city depending on the time.


We can't give you any information about when this update will be released as it is [obviously] very big.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Little Hotfix - V0.3.2
notes.notes:
The new prices for specific regions have been approved!

Added
- The cops blocking the road towards the rich region now have a rest animation instead of a T-pose.
 

Changed:
- The money stealing chance had its development value (95%) which basically caused each NPC to pay less than they should, it now depends on the personality of the NPC itself and can vary between [b ]0% to 90%.

- The NPCs now have a 20% chance to visit a random shop instead of 10% (it could still be one you don't currently own).


Fixed:
- NPCs could get stuck in the shops and never actually pay. [Thanks to @blissella1990 for reporting it]
- The "MegaCube" had a wrong name ("Playbox 4").


Also, we are currently working on a demo version of our game so everyone can try it before they buy it. :)

Kind regards!

notes.title: Big upcoming update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

As you have probably already seen, our release date has been pushed back a bit, this is due to the following update that we want to finish by then!
- don't worry, the wait will be worth it!

What exactly does this update include?
Good question!

- New NPC models (about 20 new models and animations for them)
- A new rich district, with particularly rich NPCs, lower theft rate and a much friendlier environment!
- Collectable bags where you can find money!
- A small tutorial to get you started, to make it easier to immerse yourself in the game.
- Side trades that bring in passive money.
- A town hall where you can get licenses for side trades.
- A skill tree through which you can unlock new products and improvements, sabotage your rival or do marketing!

Be curious!

notes.title: Some Bugfixes and more.
notes.notes:
Bugfixes
- It was possible to duplicate Items with the Hotbar of the players Inventory.

- Whenever the player redefined the Render-Distance Setting, the Shadow Quality Setting had changed aswell.

- The base amount of Shop Items (1) had changed when the player had this item in its inventory.

- After reloading the game, the Shop couldn't detect Items in the Hotbar which resulted in multiple stacks (the Hotbar stack and a new one in the Inventory) when the Items were bought again.

- On some locations the player was not able to jump even if he should have been able to do so.


Changes

- The default volume was lowered (Music-Volume and SFX-Volume).

- The gravity has been increased, the players jump height has been increased a bit aswell.


Hinzugefügt

- The player can now interact with Escape and Return in the main menu (Escape = close / disagree, Return = agree / proceed)

- The Shop-Sign UI now has a close button.

- Translations for Interaction-UI buttons.
